name: HAS_MATCH
description: 1 when the report comes from a watched match (match data at +0 filled), 0 otherwise
evidence: 0x7b6f76 sets 1 when the fixture argument is non-null, then fill_match_record_from_fixture(fixture, club, report) at 0x7b6fb9; 0x7b6fcb sets 0 without fixture

name: LEAGUE_MATCH
description: 1 when the watched fixture's HOME_SIDE_MARK byte (+0x40) is 0 (league match by that field's reading)
evidence: 0x7b6f7d..0x7b6f89: bl=[fixture+0x40]; sete dl; mov [esi+0x62],edx; fixture::HOME_SIDE_MARK is league 0 / cup 1 [inference]

name: ELIGIBILITY_NOTE
description: eligibility note: 1 needs a work permit (outcome in WORK_PERMIT_GRANTED), 2 eligible through a second nationality of membership group 2, 0 none
evidence: 0x7b6fd8: 1 when player_needs_work_permit (0x8c7560) != 0; 0x7b7006: 2 when nation GROUP_MEMBERSHIP (+0x7f) != 2 but the second nation's is 2 and the scout's club nation ACTUAL_REGION (+0x76) == 0xe; else 0

name: WORK_PERMIT_GRANTED
description: 1 when the needed work permit would be granted; 0 when refused or when no permit is needed
evidence: 0x7b6ea6..0x7b6ec8: [esp+0x28] = is_work_permit_granted (0x8c7950) != 0; 0x7b6fdc stores it with ELIGIBILITY_NOTE = 1, else 0
